floor_history.headline: Recon: mapped $v0/$v1 rotation + confirmed distinct-literal re-mat mechanism (clean floor 18; imported 12 depends on a reviewer-FAIL do-while barrier).

STRUCTURAL: clean floor 18 -> 4 (build_insns 79 == target); a sandbox-0 form exists but is a cross-jump-dead @4/@0xC duplication cheat (layer-1 reviewer FAIL). Natural-0 blocker = sched1 hoist of var_

frontier.hypothesis: A clean C exists that keeps var_v0's li in the arm delay slot (defeating the sched1 hoist) WITHOUT an arm-local sb, giving target's cross-block structure and a natural 0.
frontier.mechanism: Target's @0xE sb is a normal merge instruction reading a cross-block var_v0 whose li is NOT hoisted; our sched1 hoists it. The per-arm @0xE pin works but glues the sb to the merge head, deferring @4/@0xC (the residual 4).
frontier.next_probe: Instrumented sched1 priority dump (BB2_SCHED_DEBUG) to learn why the priority-0 (no in-block successor) var_v0 li is picked first; then find an in-arm consumer of var_v0 that pins the li WITHOUT emitting a cross-jump-mergeable sb (e.g. a value dependency), or a byte-store reorder that changes the ready-list tiebreak.

frontier.hypothesis: If the sched1 hoist proves un-defeatable by clean C, whether the byte-neutral @4/@0xC duplicated-statement-into-arms (store-order variant) is a sanctioned closing form is an owner/ruling question.
frontier.mechanism: duplicated-statement-into-arms sanctions the family for RA-priority effects with FAKE annotation + exhaustion + layer-2; this use is store-scheduling order. Reviewer flagged it FAIL; self-sanctioning is disallowed.
frontier.next_probe: After exhausting the hoist-defeat search, if duplication remains the only 0-path, escalate the store-order-duplication classification (ruling-request) rather than self-approve.
